# Pipelines

A pipeline is a class with a `run(bbox, output_dir, **arguments)` method that returns a `PipelineResult`. The registry
helpers `get_pipeline`, `list_pipelines`, `pipeline_kinds` and `pipeline_catalogue` look them up by name. Each concrete
class below is the code behind one catalogue page; the `run` signature lists the arguments and their defaults.

**Explained in:** [Pipelines](../../pipelines/index.md) · [The catalogue](../../pipelines/catalog/index.md) · [Reading results](../../pipelines/results.md) · [Write your own pipeline](../../pipelines/custom.md)

This page documents **57 public classes and functions** in 8 modules.

## `pygeovision.ai.pipelines`

PyGeoVision geospatial pipelines.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `PipelineResult` | class | Result of one pipeline run (used by every pipeline in the catalogue). |
| `ModelWeightsRequired` | class | Raised instead of running a network that has no trained weights. |
| `BasePipeline` | class | Abstract base for all PyGeoVision pipelines. |
| `LandCoverPipeline` | class | Land cover for an area of interest. |
| `WaterBodiesPipeline` | class | Surface water from McFeeters' NDWI = (green - NIR) / (green + NIR). |
| `ChangeDetectionPipeline` | class | Bi-temporal change detection. |
| `BuildingFootprintsPipeline` | class | Building footprints for a bounding box -- from a published dataset, or from a network you trained. |
| `CropMonitoringPipeline` | class | Crop-type mapping with a network you trained (``checkpoint=`` required). |
| `SolarDetectionPipeline` | class | Solar-panel segmentation with a network you trained (``checkpoint=`` required). |
| `DisasterAssessmentPipeline` | class | Damage assessment from a pre/post-event pair with your trained siamese network. |
| `DeforestationPipeline` | class | Forest-loss mapping with your trained change network. |
| `UrbanGrowthPipeline` | class | Urban-expansion mapping from Landsat pairs with your trained change network. |
| `pipeline_catalogue` | function | Every pipeline (core + domain), keyed by name. |
| `get_pipeline` | function | Instantiate a pipeline by name. |
| `list_pipelines` | function | Sorted names of every pipeline. |
| `pipeline_kinds` | function | ``{name: "ready" \| "needs_weights"}`` for every pipeline. |

## `pygeovision.ai.pipelines.domains`

Domain pipelines: published indices, terrain maths and reference products.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `CropHealthPipeline` | class | Vegetation-stress anomaly: where NDVI dropped between two dates. |
| `VegetationIndicesPipeline` | class | NDVI, EVI and NDWI for each date in a time series. |
| `WaterQualityPipeline` | class | NDCI chlorophyll index inside the water mask (Sentinel-2). |
| `FloodMappingPipeline` | class | Flood extent = water on the flood date that was not water before. |
| `CoastalMonitoringPipeline` | class | Shoreline change from MNDWI land/water masks on two dates. |
| `WetlandMappingPipeline` | class | Open water vs inundated (wet) vegetation. |
| `WildfireSeverityPipeline` | class | Burn severity from dNBR (Key & Benson 2006). |
| `SnowCoverPipeline` | class | Snow/ice extent from NDSI = (green - SWIR1) / (green + SWIR1) > 0.4. |
| `GlacierMonitoringPipeline` | class | Snow/ice extent change between two dates (NDSI > 0.4). |
| `UrbanHeatIslandPipeline` | class | Land surface temperature and its hot areas, from Landsat thermal. |
| `LandSurfaceTemperaturePipeline` | class | Landsat land surface temperature (same product as ``urban_heat_island``). |
| `VolcanoMonitoringPipeline` | class | Thermal anomalies: pixels more than 20 deg C above the scene mean (default). |
| `local_shannon` | function | Shannon diversity H' = -sum(p ln p) of class proportions in a moving window. |
| `BiodiversityHotspotPipeline` | class | Habitat diversity map from the ESA WorldCover 2021 reference map. |
| `SolarPotentialPipeline` | class | Clear-sky relative solar irradiance on terrain at one date and hour. |
| `ArchaeologicalSitePipeline` | class | Relief-enhancement layers for visual archaeological survey (not detection). |
| `WindFarmSitingPipeline` | class | Terrain and land-use screen for wind-farm siting (not a wind resource assessment). |

## `pygeovision.ai.pipelines.reference_products`

Pipelines that map a *published product* for a bounding box -- no imagery search, no network of ours.

| Name | Kind | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `LandCoverChangePipeline` | class | What changed between two years of the 10 m annual land-cover map, and into what. |
| `UrbanExpansionPipeline` | class | New and lost built-up area between two years of the 10 m annual land-cover map. |
| `ForestChangePipeline` | class | Forest loss and gain between two years of the JAXA PALSAR forest / non-forest map. |
| `SurfaceWaterDynamicsPipeline` | class | Where water has been permanent, seasonal, lost or new over 1984-2020 (JRC Global Surface Water). |
| `EvapotranspirationPipeline` | class | Annual evapotranspiration (ET) and potential ET for one year from MODIS MOD16A3GF. |
| `ActiveFirePipeline` | class | Days with a MODIS active-fire detection, per 1 km pixel, over a period. |

Flood mapping that combines Sentinel-1 radar, Sentinel-2 optical imagery and terrain.
